_comments.signup: Used for signup + account creation flows (mainly TC1 Register User, and any test that creates a new account). checkboxes controls newsletter/offer tick behavior.
_comments.checkout_signup: Used for checkout-related signup/address flows (TC14, TC15, TC23, TC24). checkboxes controls newsletter/offer tick behavior.
_comments.login: Used for login flows. Currently used: login.valid (TC20), login.invalid (TC3), login.logout_user (TC4). Note: TC2 and TC16 now create fresh accounts inside the test, so they do not use login.valid/place_order_user.
_comments.existing_signup: Used for negative signup validation when trying to signup with an already-registered email (TC5).
_comments.contact_us: Used for Contact Us form submission (TC6).
_comments.subscription: Used for subscription email input in footer (TC10 home page + TC11 cart page).
_comments.search: Used for product search keyword (TC9 + TC20).
_comments.payment: Used for entering card/payment details during order placement (TC14/TC15/TC16/TC24).
_comments.order: Used for checkout order comment before placing order (TC14/TC15/TC16/TC24).
_comments.products: Central control for product indices/quantity used across product/cart tests (TC8/TC12/TC13/TC14/TC17/TC20/TC23/TC24).
_comments.categories: Central control for category navigation values (TC18).
_comments.brands: Central control for brand navigation values (TC19).
